steward_aw.note: Exact-name and related web searches found no relevant primary source for STEWARD-AW or its nine-antibiotic cohort. Do not describe a chosen nine-drug list as the standard without an instructor source.

sources.title: ARMD article, author manuscript
evidence: Pages 3-4: adults, urine/blood/respiratory cultures; repeated cultures within two weeks excluded upstream.
Page 4: random date offsets are applied per patient and preserve relative timing.
Page 5: laboratory window is 14 days before culture order; vital-sign window is 48 hours before order.
Page 7: 751075 culture records and 283715 patients in the full resource; December 1999 to February 2024, with increased coverage after Epic adoption in 2008.
Page 7: NULL comorbidity end dates mean ongoing conditions, not absence.
Pages 1 and 3: two affiliated hospitals within Stanford Health Care.

sources.title: ARMD Dryad data and README
evidence: Link fields: anon_id, pat_enc_csn_id_coded, order_proc_id_coded, order_time_jittered_utc.
Ward documentation lists inpatient, outpatient, ER and ICU flags. A separate hospital identity was not verified.
Demographics contain age bins and anonymous binary gender codes; do not assign sex names to codes.
Microbial resistance table supplies resistant_time_to_culturetime; historical timing needs validation before feature use.
Implied susceptibilities and their rules are separate files.
Intermediate includes susceptible-dose-dependent. Inconclusive and synergy are separate outcomes.

design_inferences: The required organism-level grain does not require organism identity to be a model input. At culture order time, exclude current organism and current susceptibility results from inputs.
If organism is used as input, call this an organism-known prediction task and disclose that exact organism-release timing cannot be checked without a result timestamp.
Patient-level shifted dates do not establish real calendar ordering across patients. A split on shifted dates is only a sensitivity analysis, not a prospective calendar-time validation.
Do not label ward-based analysis as external hospital validation. With one identifiable source, disclose that independent site validation is unavailable.
Only measured susceptible and resistant records should define the primary target. Never use current MICs, susceptibility panels, derived resistance flags or implied labels as predictors.

Historical exposure and resistance features need an explicit sign convention, strict pre-order cutoffs, and one-row-per-event aggregation before merging. Missing linkage is not evidence of no exposure.
